'''Fairchild Island''' (Japanese: '''デカポン島''' ''Dekapon Island'') is an island in the [[Orange Islands]]. It appeared in ''[[EP104|Bound for Trouble]]''.

Fairchild Island is a mixture of forested and rocky terrain. {{Tracey}} suspected that the island's {{pkmn2|giant}} {{p|Pidgeot}} and {{p|Rhydon}} reached to their current gargantuan sizes because of Fairchild Island's fruit-filled forests. There are many resident [[wild Pokémon]] that will attack anyone who makes their way onto the island.

==History==
In ''[[EP104|Bound for Trouble]]'', {{MTR}} and [[Ash's Pikachu]] were bound together by a rope after {{TRT}} tried to steal Pikachu once again. However, a giant Pidgeot swooped in and grabbed them. Pikachu managed to free himself and Meowth from Pidgeot's talons with {{m|Thunderbolt}}, but he still had to deal with the island's giant Pokémon while trying to reunite with Ash.
